statement.p: The value of a car, V, in dollars, is a function of the number of years, t, since it was purchased; that is, V=g(t).

The independent variable is
?
t
V
g with units
?
dollars
years
dollars/year .

The dependent variable is
?
t
V
g with units
?
dollars
years
dollars/year .

solution.p: The independent variable is t and has units of years. The dependent variable is V and has units of dollars.
